demo.cliff: the interval is displayed and never scheduled
teaches: The four fields of an affliction: `difficulty`, `damage`, `effect` and `interval`.
`subType: "disease"` is one of the two the system resists with Endurance — the pair is exactly `disease` and `poison`.
`damage` is a real Foundry formula and goes through the damage chain like any other wound.
demo.trap: `interval` is a sentence the referee reads. Nothing in this system ticks a clock: no timer fires, no reminder appears, and the only automatic interval anywhere is the combat round.

system.description: Caught off the tidal flats. It starts as a cough and ends as a week in a bunk.
system.effect: While it runs, every physical check is made at DM-1.
